correctness.rationale: Independent reconstruction from the 22 integer vertices printed in Wuebben Theorem 6.1 first identified 26 polar facet normals by a convex-hull triangulation and exact primitive normals. An independent 4-combination ordering of the input vertices recovered the author-package polar indexing. Polar has 22 facets and 68 two-faces, including exactly 26 four-vertex squares; each square gives a unique diagonal equality and a 26-coordinate row with four ±1 entries. An independent Gram-minor test found all 325 pairs independent and exactly five of the 2600 three-row supports dependent. It matched ALL original one-based row triples (7,8,22),(12,14,20),(13,14,23),(17,18,25),(19,20,26) and exact matrix rank 18. Three-way Gram determinants and exact row addition/primitive sign relations certify girth 3; complete finite enumeration is itself the proof. Initial differently ordered polar normals produced a relabeling of the same five circuits; canonical package ordering resolved the discrepancy and should not be confused with new science.
